title: Milk for Every Cup

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: The cups are on the table. Let's practise pouring, so tomorrow's cups are just right.

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Steady hands! Stop at the line.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Fill each cup to its line. Hold the jug over a cup, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each cup to its line: three quarters, a quarter, half, and full.

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: You pour like you've been doing it all your life.

journal_line: I poured milk for the harvest table.
unavailable_text: The milk is poured for today.
